snippet.title: Drakojan Skies 2013 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ORIGINAL WORK BY OMEGADRAGON3000(Mike Wemhoff)

„Drakojan Skies“ is finally here! After 6 years since “Drakojan Skies Acolytes” was released in 2007, the series returns with an all new reboot! Blast your way through four stages in “Arcade Mode” then chose whichever stage order you want to play in “Open Mode”. The game also features incredible conceptual artwork and mechanical designs by artist Zaeta-K!
